**STEP 1 - Scene:** A plated meal, photographed from above on a glass table. It has a flatbread with sauce and cheese, grilled meat, shredded meat or herb salad, roasted potatoes, and green pepper strips.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** A white square plate, roughly 26 cm across. Using a round-equivalent diameter of 26 cm gives area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Flatbread with tomato sauce and cheese; grilled meat chunks; shredded meat/herb mix; roasted potato cubes; green pepper strips.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 355 g of food covering roughly 58% of a 26 cm plate is plausible. Several hundred kcal for a full plated main course is also reasonable. Estimates are rough, since the meat and bread types are inferred from appearance.
